tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

ESI Registration certificate copy with last two year payment details along with updated challen. 10 Marks
Labour Registration Certificate of Establishment Form C 10 Marks

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs 8.835 Lakhs Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. Conditional Banker Certificate is Not acceptable 10 Marks

The bidder must have provided at least 05 personnel read with clause 2 above on average in three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 .or Similar Man power Service value not less than Rs 14.725 Lakhs in Last Three year in any one year 20 Marks
The Bidder shall have the financial annual turnover in at least one financial year in the preceding three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 two times the bid value Rs 29.45 Lakhs 20 Marks
The bidder should submit a valid firm registration certificate. 5 Marks
